site.name: FMW
site.description: FMW Electronics specializes in high-performance analog ICs, power devices and power-management solutions — with part selection, technical docs and mass-production support.

home.heroSubtitle: From consumer electronics to industrial and new energy, FMW provides the reliable silicon foundation for every circuit board.
home.adv1Desc: In-house wafer process, packaging and test — mastering the whole device chain.
home.adv2Desc: Tiered verification: key parameters ship with bench-tested evidence.
home.adv3Desc: Shipped from the domestic hub with COA; overseas projects supported locally by distributors.
home.seriesDesc: Three product lines organized by application — from signal-chain supply to power switching.
home.ctaDesc: Send the part number and volume. Selection advice, samples and lead time within one business day.

about.title: About FMW
about.subtitle: A semiconductor company focused on high-performance ICs.
about.missionBody: Empower the intelligence and green transition of every industry with reliable, low-power chips.
about.cultureBody: Customer-centric, engineer-driven culture, and long-term craftsmanship on every chip.
about.qualityBody: Every specification is labelled with its verification level: datasheet value, internal bench test, or third-party certification. Bench results cite the report reference, and certified figures trace back to third-party lab reports — so qualification reviews do not require round trips to confirm which number is trustworthy.
about.globalBody: Samples and volume orders ship from the domestic hub, with COA and export documentation available on request. Overseas projects are supported locally by our distributor network, with engineers scheduled to the customer's timezone.
